candidates.description: These tokens represent common combining vowel signs and consonant-vowel characters from the Devanagari script.
This vector is related to subword tokens starting with Devanagari vowel and consonant characters.
This vector activates on various forms of the Hindi vowel sign 'e' (े) and common character combinations containing it.
This vector represents common Hindi consonants, consonant clusters, and vowel-consonant combinations.
These tokens represent various characters and consonants from the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Nepali.
These tokens represent common prefixes, roots, and numerals frequently occurring in Hindi text.
This feature detects Devanagari script characters and sub-word tokens commonly found in Hindi text encoding.
This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi devanagari consonant conjuncts and sub-word fragments.
This feature vector represents Hindi conditional and temporal conjunctions, interrogatives, and related grammatical morphemes.
This vector represents sequential numbers, specifically within the one-hundred-eighties range.
